reportFormat: Raw npm output with Node.js spec reporter
environment: Local Ganache EVM for contract tests and Node.js VM synthetic wallet for deployment-helper tests; no public network writes
contractChecks: Exact native token supply and payer-balance decrease
No mint tokens retained by NFT contract
Three lifetime mints per payer, unchanged by ordinary transfers
Immediate transfer inside ERC721 callback does not release mint quota
All 495 shard ranges and Merkle leaves
Invalid, truncated, extended and substituted proofs
Changed token code and substituted immutable index
Rejected safe-mint callback fully rolls back burn, allowance and quota
No-op, diverted and reverting token burns rejected
Swallowed and propagated callback reentrancy failures
ERC721 transfer authorization and approval clearing
Full 495-NFT sellout and exact 99-million-token supply reduction
deploymentHelperChecks: Normal creation transaction binds payer, chain 4663, exact prepared calldata and zero value
Explicit transaction chain binding prevents wrong-chain broadcast after silent final chain switch
Late account recheck stops silent account changes before requesting a signature
Account-change events invalidate deployment even when the original account is restored
Chain-change events invalidate deployment even when chain 4663 is restored
Substituted token and index runtime code stop before requesting a signature
Recorded browser transaction prevents duplicate deployment requests
Connect cannot alter pending deployment state while runtime checks are awaiting
limitations: Mock-token suite is not a substitute for actual GH0ST runtime fork validation
Wallet cap is per address; it does not prevent one person using multiple wallets
Wallets can hold more than three NFTs received by transfer; only primary lifetime mints are capped
This is automated testing, not an external security audit
Synthetic wallet tests verify helper behavior; the signing wallet must enforce explicit chain binding and the user must inspect its confirmation
A prepared unsigned deployment is not a public deployment receipt
